mode_scope: RC command-driven actuator enable; autonomous mission policy and handheld are separate
timing_status: Illustrative behavioral scenarios only; no actual hardware timing or maximum safe stop interval selected.
rules: Start LOCKED; missing, unknown or failed permission cannot enable output.
All five health permissions plus a fresh service history must hold continuously for the qualification interval.
Require at least two distinct accepted service-strobe rises in the current healthy epoch. The strobe must return low before another rise; a held-high level is not repeated service.
A new acknowledge edge, arm low and completed qualification unlock to READY.
Only a subsequent low-to-high arm_request edge from READY may enable.
Loss of any permission or service expiration while READY/ARMED locks; fault wins over same-step acknowledge/arm.
No auto-rearm after restored power/service. Deliberate low arm, new acknowledge edge, then new arm edge required.
Normal arm-low disarm with healthy permissions returns READY.
At exactly watchdog deadline the service is expired; a late/new pulse in that step cannot hide the expiration.
The model assumes command_service_edge is issued only after new valid command processing; periodic stale strobes can fool a hardware watchdog.
Time is monotonic; all inputs booleans and finite nonnegative safe integer times/config required; invalid updates must not mutate state.
qualification_holds: No receiver-ready wires exist in ACT-02. Boolean ready inputs are proposed interface contracts, not observed hardware signals.
Exact local/remote voltage thresholds, hysteresis and deglitch intervals pending load identities and receiver limits.
Discrete sampled model omits analog ramps, propagation delays, noise and faults between steps.
Output is a permission proposal; TXU HiZ does not imply zero volts or a stopped motor.
Invalid step input throws with no new permission result. Integrations must lock/disable on rejection, never reuse a previous enabled state.
